meaning: this one / that one (near you) / that one over there / which one
gist: これ・それ・あれ pick a thing by whose territory it is in (or by distance). They stand alone as pronouns — これは本です — not これ本. どれ asks "which one?" Soft polite cousins こちら / どちら show up in service talk.

rows: それはだれの[傘|かさ]ですか。
どれですか。 / [私|わたし]の[鞄|かばん]はどれですか。
formation.note: これ / それ / あれ / どれ are pronouns: they replace a noun. To modify a noun (this book), you need この / その / あの — taught next. Soft/polite: こちら ≈ this way / this one; どちら ≈ which (one/way).

explanation: Japanese pointing words track speaker and listener, not only meters on the floor. Territory model: これ is in the speaker's space (in your hand, at your desk); それ is in the listener's space (what they are holding or just mentioned); あれ is outside both spaces (across the room, that building over there). Distance model is the same three-way split taught as near / mid / far when territory is unclear. どれ asks which one among options: どれですか / 私の鞄はどれですか. Keep the copula in polite classroom speech: これは本です. Soft polite cousins こちら and どちら appear in service talk.

senses.label: これ — near the speaker
senses.body: Use when the thing is in your space: in your hand, on your desk, next to you.
senses.example_ruby: これは[私|わたし]の[本|ほん]です。

senses.label: それ — near the listener
senses.body: Also for something the listener just named: A「これは鞄です。」B「それは何の鞄ですか。」
senses.example_ruby: それは[先生|せんせい]の[傘|かさ]ですか。
senses.example_en: Is that (by you) the teacher's umbrella?

senses.label: あれ — away from both
senses.body: Far from speaker and listener, or not in either person's immediate space.

senses.label: どれ — which one
senses.body: Question word for choosing among things. Soft polite cousin: どちらですか.
senses.example_ruby: [私|わたし]の[鞄|かばん]はどれですか。

register_context: Classroom default: これ／それ／あれ＋です. Plain form: これだ / それだ. Soft/polite service style often prefers こちら／そちら／あちら and どちら over bare これ／どれ. Negatives from earlier Unit 1 still attach normally: これは鞄じゃないです / あれは駅ではありません.

mistakes.why: これ cannot sit directly before a noun. Standalone pronoun: これは本です. Before a noun you need この本 (taught in この・その・あの).

mistakes.wrong_ruby: (You are holding the book.) それは[本|ほん]です。
mistakes.why: Near the speaker → これ, not それ. If it is in your hands, use これ.

mistakes.wrong_ruby: どれは[私|わたし]の[鞄|かばん]ですか。
mistakes.right_ruby: [私|わたし]の[鞄|かばん]はどれですか。
mistakes.why: Question words like どれ do not take topic は. Put the known noun as topic and どれ in the comment: 私の鞄はどれですか.

contrasts.label: これ vs この本
contrasts.summary: これ stands alone (a pronoun). この must be followed by a noun: この本. Same for それ/その, あれ/あの.
contrasts.ex_a_en: This one is a book. (これ = the thing itself)
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: この[本|ほん]は[私|わたし]のです。
contrasts.ex_b_en: This book is mine. (この + noun)

contrasts.label: Territory vs raw distance
contrasts.summary: If you hold it, say これ even if the listener is closer on a map. If they hold it, say それ even when you could almost touch it.
contrasts.ex_a_ruby: これは[私|わたし]の[電話|でんわ]です。
contrasts.ex_a_en: (In my hand) This is my phone.
contrasts.ex_b_ruby: それは[私|わたし]の[電話|でんわ]ですか。
contrasts.ex_b_en: (In your hand) Is that my phone?

contrasts.label: どれ vs どこ
contrasts.summary: どれ = which thing; どこ = which place / where. Different question words.

examples.ruby: それは[私|わたし]の[傘|かさ]ですか。

examples.english: That over there is the station.

examples.ruby: [私|わたし]の[鞄|かばん]はどれですか。
examples.note: どれ · noun は どれですか

examples.ruby: それは[先生|せんせい]のじゃないです。
examples.note: それ · near you · negative じゃないです

examples.ruby: これは[友達|ともだち]の[電話|でんわ]です。
あれは[大学|だいがく]ではありません。
examples.english: That over there is not a university.

dialogue.ruby: それは[私|わたし]の[本|ほん]です。
dialogue.english: That is my book. (A's これ → B's それ)

dialogue.english: Is that over there a book, too?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.ruby: いいえ、あれは[鞄|かばん]です。
dialogue.english: No, that over there is a bag.

checks.prompt: (You are holding a book.) （　）は本です。
checks.why: In the speaker's hands → これ (territory near speaker).

checks.prompt: (Pointing at an umbrella next to the listener.) （　）はだれの傘ですか。
(The station is far from both of you.) （　）は駅です。
checks.why: Away from speaker and listener → あれ.

checks.prompt: (You want to ask which one is your bag.) 私の鞄は（　）ですか。
checks.why: Asking which of several → どれ. Context forces the question word, not pointing with あれ. どこ is for places.
